title: Dual finite-free system criterion for flat Mittag-Leffler modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $M$ be a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed partially ordered set, and let $(M_i,f_{ij})_{i\in I}$ be a system of finite free $R$-modules whose compatible maps $f_i:M_i\to M$ exhibit $M$ as its colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose that the inverse system of dual modules is Mittag-Leffler, meaning explicitly that for every $i\in I$ there exists $j\ge i$ such that for every $k\ge j$ the images of the precomposition maps $\operatorname{Hom}_R(M_k,R)\to\operatorname{Hom}_R(M_i,R)$ and $\operatorname{Hom}_R(M_j,R)\to\operatorname{Hom}_R(M_i,R)$ are equal. Then $M$ is Mittag-Leffler in the tensor-product sense [def-trf-mittag-leffler-module].
